categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu LiXing General Steel Ball Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of precision bearing rolling elements, including bearing steel balls and bearing rollers. The company serves various industries such as automotive (fuel and new energy vehicles), precision CNC machine tools, light industry appliances, robotics, wind power, construction machinery, aerospace, rail transit, and heavy-duty equipment. It also produces ceramic balls and is expanding into high-end nitride ceramic rolling elements.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses internationally advanced core technologies and production processes for bearing steel balls, including ball blank heading, heat treatment, surface strengthening, resin wheel precision grinding, and multi-level non-destructive testing. It has developed high-precision cold heading and grinding processes for rollers, including high-speed multi-station cold heading and environmentally friendly decarburization-free heat treatment. The company also focuses on intelligent manufacturing, digital management platforms, and innovative ceramic ball production technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include the global top eight bearing manufacturers such as SKF, GKN, JTEKT, and ILJIN. The company serves high-end bearing manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, wind power, rail transit, and precision machinery sectors. Its products are sold domestically and exported to over 30 countries including the USA, Germany, France, Italy, Mexico, Japan, and South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Henan, and overseas manufacturing facilities in the USA (South Carolina) and Mexico (Monterrey). It has established a global sales and service network covering major markets in North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu LiXing operates in the midstream of the supply chain as a manufacturer of precision rolling elements (steel balls, rollers, ceramic balls) that are key components for bearing manufacturers downstream. It procures high-quality bearing steel from upstream steel producers and supplies finished rolling elements to bearing manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and R&D in high-precision rolling elements, intelligent manufacturing, and green production. Key R&D projects include intelligent heat treatment, ultra-precision grinding for new energy vehicle steel balls, high-speed railway bearing rollers, and high-end nitride ceramic balls. It collaborates with the Chinese Academy of Sciences on ceramic ball technology and focuses on import substitution and expanding high-end product lines.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision bearing rolling elements including steel balls, rollers, and ceramic balls. The company uses a direct sales model domestically and internationally, with pricing based on material, precision grade, and customer-specific requirements negotiated annually.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Japan's Tsubaki Nakashima, Shandong Dong'e Steel Ball Co., Ningbo Haiyate Rollers, and Dalian Weiyuan Bearing Co. The company is the domestic leader in precision bearing steel balls, the only domestic enterprise in the global top eight bearing manufacturers' procurement system, and holds a strong competitive position with advanced technology and stable high-end customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.045 billion, a 4.29% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 55.23 million, slightly down by 7.76%. The company maintains steady growth with total assets of about RMB 1.913 billion and net assets of RMB 1.254 billion as of year-end 2024. R&D investment accounted for over 5% of revenue, supporting sustainable innovation-driven growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu LiXing offers high-quality, precision-engineered rolling elements with international advanced technology and core proprietary processes. Its products meet stringent quality standards required by global top bearing manufacturers, providing superior durability, precision, and performance. The company’s intelligent manufacturing and digital management systems ensure consistent product quality and traceability, while its strategic focus on high-end ceramic balls and customized solutions differentiates it in the market.
